description: This file implements classes and functions related to Vsync timing and phase offset configurations for SurfaceFlinger in Android, including handling of refresh rates, phase offsets, and work durations.

classes.name: VsyncConfiguration
classes.description: Handles Vsync configuration based on refresh rate, providing methods to get configs and dump current settings.

classes.name: VsyncConfigSet
classes.description: Represents a set of Vsync configuration offsets and durations.

classes.name: PhaseOffsets
classes.description: Manages phase offset configurations for different refresh rates, including default and high FPS offsets.

classes.name: WorkDuration
classes.description: Defines work durations and offsets for rendering phases, with properties for early and late durations.

methods.name: VsyncConfiguration::getConfigsForRefreshRate
methods.description: Returns Vsync configs for a given refresh rate.

methods.name: VsyncConfiguration::dump
methods.description: Outputs current Vsync configuration details into a string.

methods.name: PhaseOffsets::constructOffsets
methods.description: Constructs offset configurations based on Vsync duration, choosing high FPS or default offsets.

methods.name: PhaseOffsets::getDefaultOffsets
methods.description: Calculates default phase offsets based on Vsync duration.

methods.name: PhaseOffsets::getHighFpsOffsets
methods.description: Calculates high FPS specific phase offsets.

methods.name: WorkDuration::constructOffsets
methods.description: Creates work duration offsets based on Vsync duration and internal properties.
